Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that the places are not in the same country by conflating an ambiguous result for “Pleshkovo” with “Pleszkowo” in Poland and treating the existence of multiple homonyms as determinative. Instead of disambiguating which “Pleshkovo” the task referred to (the Russian localities sharing that transliteration), the Planner assumed a Polish instance and drew an incorrect conclusion, despite clear evidence that Tomskoye, Amur Oblast is in Russia and that there are multiple Pleshkovo locations in Russia as well.
